description: Vehicles: what a wallet's declared ground vehicle gives it as the DRIVER of a convoy hit or a Ledger job: speed odds, armour against a failed chase, and an extra cargo cut of the winning vault (basis points; 100 = 1 point). Read only. Declare a vehicle with prepare_vehicle_bring.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: vehicle_edge
